title: VIP's phone stolen, asks for an MFA reset (logged by phone)

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
My phone was stolen on Saturday. I've got a new one but I can't approve any sign-ins so I can't get into email or anything else. Can you reset my MFA so I can set up the new phone?

Priya

relevant: Setting up MFA on a new phone

handling.escalation_reason: An MFA reset needs identity verification, and for a VIP the line manager's too.

rationale: A VIP fully blocked is P1 by definition. A stolen phone is security-sensitive, and resetting MFA methods removes a security control (G4). The MFA runbook's 'old phone is gone' section says: verify by video or in person first, and for VIPs involve the line manager.
